root_cause: End-to-end live Playwright + PostgreSQL QA surfaced: (1) opposite lock order in send_store_message() vs contact_event() causing PostgreSQL deadlocks, (2) BulkImportRowInput rejecting listing_id-based spreadsheet updates expected by docs/API_SPECIFICATION.md and MerchantPortal, (3) moderation_queue ascending pk truncation hiding newly flagged listings and causing stale version 409 on clear, (4) merchant registration sending lat/lng and calling updateStoreProfile/submitVerification before OTP verification while CustomerApp closed entryScreen prematurely, (5) AdminCatalogPanel calling merchant-only /catalog/brands with limit=200 and omitting model edit, (6) MerchantPortal settings hydration leaving phone/whatsapp empty or clobbering dirty edits, (7) mapDualApproval leaving pending status unmapped and blocking self-approval UI detection, and (8) window.open('noopener') navigating away on WhatsApp handoff plus missing <html dir> sync.
fix_summary: Enforced uniform Store->Listing locking order in send_store_message, supported listing_id and *_count fields in BulkImportRowInput/bulk_import_listings, prioritized flagged listings in moderation_queue with synchronous listing state updates on moderate, moved store profile/verification submission cleanly after merchant OTP verify with latitude/longitude and required id_front upload, switched AdminCatalogPanel to public paginated catalog endpoints with Model Edit modal, fixed MerchantPortal Settings hydration/dirty guards, mapped DualApproval pending->awaiting_second_approval, preserved non-verified/flagged records across public refreshes, and fixed WhatsApp opener and HTML dir syncing.
